ITEM 1 | Two pieces of golden-brown, pan-seared meat with crisp, deeply browned edges and a dry, slightly crusty surface; the interior is pale and fibrous with some darker speckled bits; the larger piece is roughly 7 x 5 cm and about 2.5 cm thick, sitting at the upper left of the plate, with the second piece about 6 x 4 cm and 2 cm thick at the lower left. Together they cover roughly 15% of the plate. | 170

ITEM 2 | Bright green, slightly glossy leafy greens with dark green wilted leaves and pale green stalks; the stalks are thick, crisp-looking, about 1 to 1.5 cm wide and 6 to 8 cm long, arranged in a loose heap across the right and center of the plate, partly sitting under and between the pieces of meat; some leaves are darker and limp, with moist sheen. Covers roughly 25% of the plate. | 130

ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green, translucent, softened chunks with a moist, slightly glossy surface, about 3 to 4 cm long, mixed in among the leafy greens on the upper right and lower center of the plate. | 35

ITEM 4 | Four small whole mushroom caps, light tan to brown, smooth and matte with a slightly moist surface, each about 2.5 to 3 cm across and 2 cm high, clustered at the lower right edge of the plate beside the greens. | 60
